description: Detect the technology stack of a website: CMS, frameworks, JavaScript libraries, analytics, CDN, hosting, fonts, security tools, and more. Returns categorized detections with confidence levels.

render.description: Rendering mode. 'never' = fast static fetch (1 credit). 'auto' = static first, browser if needed. 'always' = browser rendering (5 credits).

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for on rendered pages.

wait_until.description: Browser navigation milestone. Only used with browser rendering.

name: tooltrace_tech_stack
